items.title: Automatic tunnel recovery
items.description: If the Windows tunnel engine unexpectedly stops, Fox VPN attempts to restore the connection automatically.

items.title: More resilient connections
items.description: Temporary account-service interruptions no longer end an active connection during routine pass renewal.

items.title: Prompt update checks
items.description: Update checks start when you open the app and refresh when you return, with downloads matched to your device.

items.title: Refined dialogs
items.description: Dialogs and selection menus follow your application theme in dark, light and system appearance.

items.title: Compact downloads
items.description: Improved standard archive compression preserves the complete application and VPN components.
